$comment: Spec §8. Source: Enzyme Site of Action deck (08.07.2026), slides 2 and 3.

regions.name: Mouth
regions.transit_note: Dwell is seconds — too brief for any enzyme to react regardless of pH fit.

regions.name: Stomach, fasting
regions.transit_note: Only acid-tolerant enzymes are active before food buffers the pH up.

regions.name: Stomach, after eating
regions.transit_note: The main workhorse zone. Food buffers pH up, then it drifts back down over roughly two hours.

regions.name: Duodenum
regions.transit_note: Fungal lactase has dropped out above its 5.4 ceiling; inulinase is fading.

regions.name: Colon
regions.transit_note: Too late — undigested substrate is fermented here, which is the symptom mechanism.
